BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Doors.

3. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

5. When learning Appropriate Technology in Building, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Appropriate Technology in Building.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.

6. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.

7. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.

8. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

10. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.

11. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Roof Construction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Doors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Windows and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Water Supply and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.

9. B — Information and Communication Technology

10. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

12. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands
